result:
I didn't ship anything this run. I ran the critic on three screens and wrote the results into the notes file.

- **17 fashion mirror:** scored 3, which meets the finish line for non-core screens.
- **18 settings hub:** scored 3, also done. Settings belongs to the c-31 task.
- **03 hub floor:** scored 2. Its biggest finding is the "credits" label in the top-right strip, but that was already fixed in v32.50, and the picture I judged was taken before that fix.

The critic also wants the "***experimental feature may glitch***" caption under the last pour deleted. I left it because it is his own rewritten wording, which earlier builds kept on purpose (v13.03, v18.96, v19.43). The other hub findings are drawn on the canvas floor, which is the hub backdrop task's territory, so I left those too.

Not yet judged: 39, 41–44, 66, 67. Screens 10, 11 and 15 scored 2 last run and need new pictures taken from the current build.

NEXT: reshoot 10, 11 and 15 and run the critic on them, then ship CSS-only fixes (lime primary buttons, 16px type floor) for whatever still scores under 3.

TASK PARTIAL: 03, 10, 11, 15, 05, 07, 13, 14 and 16 still score 2 or lower; 39, 41–44, 66 and 67 are unjudged.
